content.text: While Newcastle United will provide Champions League football in the upcoming season, they have yet to make any moves in the transfer market, as they continue to be surrounded by speculation and rumors concerning potential signings.

Rob: Great first summer signing. Eddie Howe will get the best out of him. I hope there is more to come. The small squad needs beefing up. It's going to be a long season. The more bodies, the better, if they want to progress in the cup competitions. Players seem to be reluctant to come this far north. Newcastle need to change that perception by having a stellar season.

It is important to note that the transfer fee can be distributed throughout the duration of his five-year contract. While this approach is a savvy business move, it still represents a considerable expense.
